name: Luoxuan Yuanwuqu
source: As the adopted girl of a family fallen from grace, you now have a chance to make your mark on high society. Through ballroom dancing and clever romancing, gather the information you need to restore your family’s name.
translation: 身为没落家族收养的女孩，如今，你终于有机会在上流社会崭露头角。通过舞会上的交际与巧妙的恋爱周旋，收集重振家族声誉所需的情报。
